company_overview: Postman is an API platform that simplifies the entire API lifecycle, from design and testing to deployment and monitoring, enabling teams to build, test, and manage APIs faster. It also offers AI-powered tools such as the AI Engineer and Agent Mode to automate API workflows and accelerate development.
target_audience: Individual developers, API teams, and enterprises that build, test, and manage APIs.
leadership: Abhinav Asthana - CEO and co-founder; Ankit Sobti - Co-founder; Abhijit Kane - Co-founder

company_overview: Supabase is an open‑source backend platform that provides a Postgres database, authentication, real‑time data, storage, and edge functions for developers. It offers a fully managed, scalable solution that lets teams build and deploy applications quickly without managing infrastructure.
target_audience: Developers building web, mobile, and AI applications who need a full‑featured, Postgres‑based backend with authentication, real‑time, storage, and serverless functions. The platform also targets startup teams, innovation teams, and enterprises looking to prototype and scale quickly.

company_overview: Vapi builds a unified platform for creating, deploying, and managing voice agents that can handle customer support, lead qualification, and appointment scheduling. The platform offers enterprise‑grade scalability, security, and compliance features such as SSO, SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI.
target_audience: Enterprises and developers building voice AI solutions for customer support, lead qualification, appointment scheduling, and other conversational use cases at scale.
leadership: Jason Mitura - VP of Software Development
